    """
    Main protocol function body for PyLabRobot.

    Args:

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Acquire pre-configured deck resources
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
    source = lh.get_resource("source_plate")
    dest = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Commitment ledger: declared plan of liquid movements
    #    Fields: source, destination, volume (uL), channel.
    #    Volumes are set to 40 uL - safely below the 50 uL tip capacity -
    #    preventing over-aspiration errors and ensuring the protocol
    #    matches its declared commitment.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    commitment_ledger = [
        {"source": "source_plate.A1", "destination": "destination_plate.A1", "volume": 40, "channel": 1},
        {"source": "source_plate.B1", "destination": "destination_plate.B1", "volume": 40, "channel": 1},
        {"source": "source_plate.C1", "destination": "destination_plate.C1", "volume": 40, "channel": 1},
    ]

    tip_positions = ["A1", "B1", "C1"]  # one fresh tip per transfer
    execution_log = []

    #    Every operation is awaited; tips are always picked up before
    #    aspiration and dropped after dispensing (trash), as required.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    for i, entry in enumerate(commitment_ledger):
        src_well = source[entry["source"].split(".")[1]]
        dst_well = dest[entry["destination"].split(".")[1]]
        volume = entry["volume"]

        # Pick up a fresh tip before any aspiration
        await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack[tip_positions[i]])

        # Aspirate exactly the committed volume from the source well
        await lh.aspirate(src_well, vols=[volume])

        # Dispense exactly the committed volume into the destination well
        await lh.dispense(dst_well, vols=[volume])

        # Drop the used tip to trash after dispensing
        await lh.drop_tips()

        # Record what was actually executed for ledger verification
        execution_log.append({
            "source": entry["source"],
            "destination": entry["destination"],
            "volume": volume,
            "channel": 1,  # single-channel head operation
        })

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Verify executed operations against the commitment ledger
    #    Checks source, destination, volume, and channel for each entry.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    discrepancies = []
    if len(execution_log) != len(commitment_ledger):
        discrepancies.append(
            f"Operation count mismatch: ledger has {len(commitment_ledger)} "
            f"entries, {len(execution_log)} were executed."
        )

    for expected, actual in zip(commitment_ledger, execution_log):
